questions.question: Find the compound interest on Rs. 8000 at 15% per annum for 2 years (compounded annually.)
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Principal (P) = Rs.8000

Rate = 15% ; time = 2 years

**Formula used:**

Amount (A) = P × (1 + R/100)T

Compound interest (C.I) = Amount (A) - principal (P)

**Calculation:**

Amount (A) = P × {1 + (R/100)}T

⇒ 8000 × {1 + (15/100)}²

 

⇒ 8000 × {23/20}²

 

⇒ 8000 × {529/400}

 

⇒ 529 × 20 = Rs.10580

 

Compound interest (C.I) = Amount (A) - principal (P)

⇒ 10580 - 8000 = Rs.2580

**∴ The correct answer is Rs.2580.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**

**Calculation:**

Effective rate for 2 years = R + R + (R × R)/100

⇒ 15 + 15 + (15 × 15)/100

⇒ 30 + 2.25 = 32.25%

Compound interest (C.I) = 8000 × 32.25% = Rs.2580

∴ The correct answer is Rs.2580

A man rows to a place situated 100 km away and comes back in 10 hours. He can row 12 km downstream or 8 km upstream in same time. What is the speed of the stream?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Since time is constant, the ratio of Downstream (D) to Upstream (U) speed is equal to the distance ratio = 12 : 8 = 3 : 2.

Let D = 3x and U = 2x. The total round-trip time for 100 km is 10 hours.

100 ÷ 3x + 100 ÷ 2x = 10 ⇒ 50 ÷ 6x = 1 ⇒ x = 25/3.

D = 3 × 25/3 = 25 km/hr and U = 2 × 25/3 = 50/3 km/hr.

Speed of stream = (D − U) ÷ 2 = (25 − 50/3) ÷ 2 = 25/6 km/hr.

**∴ The correct answer is 25/6 km/hr.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Total distance of one-way journey = 100 km

Total time taken for the round trip = 10 hours

Distance covered downstream in time t = 12 km

Distance covered upstream in time t = 8 km

**Formula Used:**

Speed = Distance ÷ Time

Speed of stream = (Downstream Speed − Upstream Speed) ÷ 2

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6c4ccab1ecab213e2770f33ed44d479849acd6615481a83aee4cfc067c2d9b76.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ The time taken to row 12 km downstream is the same as the time to row 8 km upstream.

⇒ Ratio of Downstream Speed (D) to Upstream Speed (U) = 12 ÷ 8 = 3 / 2

⇒ Let D = 3x km/hr and U = 2x km/hr

⇒ Total time for the round trip = 10 hours

⇒ (100 ÷ 3x) + (100 ÷ 2x) = 10

⇒ Dividing the entire equation by 10:

⇒ (10 ÷ 3x) + (10 ÷ 2x) = 1

⇒ (20 + 30) ÷ 6x = 1

⇒ 50 ÷ 6x = 1

⇒ x = 25/3

⇒ Downstream Speed (D) = 3 × (25/3) = 25 km/hr

⇒ Upstream Speed (U) = 2 × (25/3) = 50/3 km/hr

⇒ Speed of stream = (D − U) ÷ 2

⇒ Speed of stream = (25 − 50/3) ÷ 2

⇒ Speed of stream = ((75 − 50) ÷ 3) ÷ 2

⇒ Speed of stream = (25/3) ÷ 2 = 25/6 km/hr

**∴ The correct answer is 25/6 km/hr.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Speed of Boat in Still Water

If downstream speed is D and upstream speed is U, then the speed of the boat in still water is calculated as (D + U) ÷ 2.

Speed of Stream

The speed of the water current (stream) is half the difference between the downstream and upstream speeds, given by the formula (D − U) ÷ 2.

Average Speed for Round Trip

When a boat travels equal distances downstream and upstream, its average speed for the entire journey is independent of distance and equals (2 × D × U) ÷ (D + U).

questions.question: The ratio of the volume of two cylinders is 27 ∶ 25 and the ratio of their heights is 3 ∶ 4. If the area of the base of the second cylinder is 3850 cm², then what will be the radius of the first cylinder?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Ratio of **(radius)²** = (V₁/V₂) × (h₂/h₁)

(r₁/r₂)² = (27/25) × (4/3) = 36/25 ⇒ r₁/r₂ = 6/5

Base Area of second cylinder = 3850 ⇒ πr₂² = 3850 ⇒ r₂ = 35 cm

Radius of first cylinder (r₁) = (6/5) × 35 = 42 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 42 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Ratio of **Volumes** (V₁ : V₂) = 27 : 25

Ratio of **Heights** (h₁ : h₂) = 3 : 4

**Base Area** of second cylinder = 3850 cm²

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8f042bb46114eb942fd73d80798564e1b1e833db735215f45427ff5c753ea728.png] 

**Formula:** Volume of Cylinder (V) = πr²h | Base Area = πr²

⇒ Base Area of second cylinder = πr₂² = 3850

⇒ (22/7) × r₂² = 3850

⇒ r₂² = (3850 × 7) / 22 = 175 × 7 = 1225

⇒ r₂ = √1225 = 35 cm

⇒ V₁ / V₂ = (r₁² × h₁) / (r₂² × h₂)

⇒ 27 / 25 = (r₁² / 35²) × (3 / 4)

⇒ r₁² = (27 / 25) × (4 / 3) × 1225

⇒ r₁² = (9 / 25) × 4 × 1225 = 9 × 4 × 49 = 1764

⇒ r₁ = √1764 = 42 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 42 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Volume of a Cylinder

The volume of a cylinder is calculated as V = πr²h, where r is the radius of the base and h is the height.

Curved Surface Area (CSA)

The area of the curved side of a cylinder is given by CSA = 2πrh.

Total Surface Area (TSA)

The total area including the two circular bases and the curved surface is TSA = 2πr(h + r).</p
